item.title: Giants trade rumors: Ravens say Derrick Henry won’t be dealt
item.description: Derrick Henry | Getty Images Plan A for the New York Giants to upgrade at running back remains a mega-deal for Jonathan Taylor . Plan B, if there is a real Plan B, won’t be Derrick Henry of the Baltimore Ravens. Per Adam Schefter, the Ravens have “informed Henry that they have no intention of trading him” to his former coach John Harbaugh and the Giants, or anywhere else. The understandable logic behind that, from a Ravens point of view, is that the Ravens are not a) giving up on this season, or b) giving up on the idea that they can retain star quarterback Lamar Jackson long term. Peter Schrager of ESPN added this on ‘GetUp’ , per Pro Football and Sports Network : “I don’t see it,” said Schrager. “My sense is this, talking to Baltimore’s sources: they have 12 draft picks in the upcoming draft, so draft capital doesn’t really do anything right now. They also play the Chargers, Panthers, Texans, Bucs the next four weeks. Those are winnable games. And they just traded for a quarterback; they traded for Cam Jurgens.” “They’re not already in this selloff, fire sale mode. They are not Tennessee, they are not Indianapolis. That said, if there are calls about some other players they would probably be listening to some. I’m talking about guys who might’ve put themselves as veterans on the trade market themselves by the way that they’ve been performing in recent weeks.” Justice Hill? Schefter mentioned in his report that the Giants had asked the Ravens about the availability of veteran running back Justice Hill . Hill was a 2019 fourth-round draft pick by the Ravens and has spent his entire career with Baltimore, so Harbaugh knows him well. The confusing thing about interest in the 28-year-old Hill is that in seven seasons he has never carried the ball more than 84 times, and has just 301 carries for his career. There is nothing on his resume to suggest he is better than Tyrone Tracy or Devin Singletary. Unless the Giants are concerned about the hamstring injuries Tryone Tracy (currently on IR) and Cam Skattebo (doubtful vs. the Eagles) are dealing with and see Hill as an emergency fill-in, I’m not sure what he adds to the backfield. Latest on Jonathan Taylor The Athletic’s Jonathan Jones believes that the Giants and Minnesota Vikings are the favorites to convince the Indianapolis Colts to trade their star running back. Jones said he was told the Colts have already rejected an offer of a second- and fifth-round pick. item.title: Joel Embiid reveals what's behind alarming 3-point shooting slump as 76ers star searches for answers
item.description: Joel Embiid reveals what's behind alarming 3-point shooting slump as 76ers star searches for answers originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Joel Embiid is dealing with unexpected shooting woes. The 76ers center and 2023 NBA MVP is shooting a career-worst 10.7% from three-point range through his first of the season. Embiid’s last made three-pointer was with 0.7 seconds left in the first half of the Sixers ’ home-opening victory over the Cleveland Cavaliers on Oct. 22. Since then, the seven-time All-Star has missed 17 consecutive attempts. As a result, he’s shooting 3-for-28 on threes. His poor shooting is unfathomable for a player who shot 33.9% from three-point range in 490 career games before this season. Embiid had one of his all-around performances of the season in a rematch with the Cavs on Friday. He finished with a season-low six points while missing all nine field-goal attempts, including both three-point tries. But his drought from deep remains a hot topic. So what’s the difference? “I think the way I’m jumping, and my hands [placement] are just not what it used to be,” Embiid said to the media. “I just have to go back and look at the clips and see what we can change and … get better.” The 32-year-old said he’s jumping differently because he played just 57 games over the previous two seasons due to injuries. “I think it’s obviously being out basically the last two years, being in and out, not really having the opportunity to get on the court as much … to get the reps,” he said. “The load that we try to manage. It’s probably a difference between the last couple of years. … I used to be able to get in the gym every single day, just getting the reps in, working on it. That’s why it was so automatic. “Now you got to find a way to kind of mix it up, because you got to manage your load. So you don’t get as much reps as possible.” Embiid knows he’ll have to adjust. The 11-year veteran said he’s going to keep working and hopes it gets better. But this is a tough situation for one of the league’s best players. “I believe in myself,” he said, “but when you’re in these moments, and nothing is going in … it’s hard not to look at yourself and be down.” For more NBA coverage, analysis and insights, subscribe to Keith Pompey’s Substack .

item.title: Minnesota Vikings Working on Daniel Jones Trade Before Tuesday? New Week 9 Rumor Offers BIG Evidence
item.description: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect Could the Minnesota Vikings be plotting a bold trade for injury-prone Indianapolis Colts quarterback Daniel Jones ? Some surprising evidence has emerged pointing to that possibility before Tuesday’s NFL trade deadline. The Vikings really don’t have a lot to complain about heading into their Week 9 matchup against the Buffalo Bills because their elite defense — which is giving up just 13 points a game — has carried them to an impressive 6-1 record. On paper, they look like Super Bowl contenders. However, their offense is why many NFL pundits have doubts about a deep playoff run this winter. The Minnesota offense is averaging 20 points per week, which is sixth-worst in the NFL . Many around the league blame that on the play they’ve gotten at quarterback from Kyler Murray or Carson Wentz. In a perfect world, the Vikings would make a trade to upgrade the position before Nov. 10. However, there aren’t realistic options out there, especially after Jacoby Brissett was traded to the Baltimore Ravens this week. Well, a new option has emerged. According to ESPN’s Adam Schefter, “ The Colts have received calls from multiple teams inquiring about trading for Jones , and Indianapolis has been willing to listen to any offers.” Indianapolis is undertaking a huge fire sale before Tuesday’s deadline. They have already moved a pair of multi-time Pro Bowlers, and many believe Jonathan Taylor and Josh Downs will be next. Why the Minnesota Vikings trading for Daniel Jones isn’t a terrible move Nov 1, 2026; Jacksonville, Florida, USA; Indianapolis Colts quarterback Daniel Jones (17) throws a pass during the first quarter against the Jacksonville Jaguars at EverBank Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Morgan Tencza-Imagn Images There really aren’t many logical options for a Jones trade right now. Maybe the Cleveland Browns if they aren’t believers in Deshaun Watson, but with a 5-3 record, that seems unlikely. The Denver Broncos could be a possibility, but many NFL experts would probably say Bo Nix is still a better option. The Vikings simply make the most sense as a Jones trade contender because they have the most obvious need at the position, and he surprisingly would be better than what they currently have. Some Vikings fans will probably roll their eyes at trading for Jones, especially since he seems to be a shell of the player who looked like a Pro Bowler in 2025 before tearing his Achilles. item.title: Week 9 sell-high trade targets: Purdy, Pollard, Wilson, Kraft at peak fantasy value
item.description: Week 9 is the time to sell high on 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy and Titans running back Tony Pollard , two fantasy football starters whose trade prices have climbed just before their schedules get considerably tougher. Purdy hosts the Raiders on Sunday before facing Minnesota and Seattle in Weeks 11 and 12, while Pollard sees Jacksonville twice in his first three games after the bye. Cardinals receiver Michael Wilson and Packers tight end Tucker Kraft are coming off strong games, and both have difficult matchups ahead. Purdy has the 49ers at 6-1 with 1,748 passing yards, 15 touchdowns and four interceptions, and he’s done it with a revolving group of receivers that shrinks again Sunday. San Francisco ruled out Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel and Christian Kirk, and Kirk’s meniscus injury could end his season . Rahm, who said recently that he does not know what 2027 holds after quitting the LIV tour, is aiming for a first solo tournament triumph since winning the Masters in 2023. Rory McIlroy had shared the lead with the Spaniard but made bogey at the par-3 No. 17 to drop into fourth place on a 34 Celsius (94 F) day at Yas Links. McIlroy’s 67 included a double-bogey six at No. 10. That blemish broke up a sequence of seven birdies between Nos. 7 and 14. NAPLES, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 13: Massimiliano Allegri SSC Napoli head coach during the Serie A match between SSC Napoli and Bologna FC at Stadio Diego Armando Maradona on September 13, 2026 in Naples, Italy. (Photo by Francesco Pecoraro/Getty Images) This clash could not come at a worse time for the Partenopei, who lost their last two matches in Serie A to Juventus and then the Champions League 4-1 away to FC Porto. That trip highlighted some tension in the team, with Matteo Politano making cryptic comments about “only the Italians” taking responsibility for poor form, and an on-field row between Kevin De Bruyne and Lorenzo Lucca. Napoli scrap Allegri press conference NAPLES, ITALY – OCTOBER 24: Massimiliano Allegri SSC Napoli head coach during the Serie A match between SSC Napoli and AS Roma at Stadio Diego Armando Maradona on October 24, 2026 in Naples, Italy. (Photo by Francesco Pecoraro/Getty Images) Allegri was scheduled to speak in a press conference this afternoon with all the media figures assembled and cameras set up, when suddenly it was announced the whole event had been cancelled with 10 minutes to spare. The unexplained turnaround only raised further questions about the situation within the Napoli camp and the future of coach Allegri. NAPLES, ITALY – JULY 14: Massimiliano Allegri new SSC Napoli head coach with Aurelio De Laurentiis SSC Napoli president Massimiliano Allegri is presented at Teatro di San Carlo on July 14, 2026 in Naples, Italy. (Photo by Francesco Pecoraro/Getty Images) The squad has been in a training retreat at the Castel Volturno camp since Friday to prepare for the match with Lazio, and President Aurelio De Laurentiis is also present. According to Sky Sport Italia , it was De Laurentiis who decided to cancel the press conference, although why it was only confirmed after everyone had assembled is unclear.

item.title: Liverpool captain Fisk signs new deal
item.description: Liverpool captain Fisk signs new deal Liverpool captain Grace Fisk has signed a new contract with the club. WSL Full-Time were informed of the news via an official club press release from The Reds this morning. The 28-year-old England international defender joined Liverpool from West Ham United in summer 2023. She has gone on to make 82 appearances for The Reds in which she has scored five goals. Fisk is a huge player for Liverpool and the club have moved to retain her services for an extended period. After extending her contract with Liverpool, Fisk said “Every day I feel really lucky to be here in the place that we get to call work. Melwood is an amazing place filled with really special people. “And the city as a whole, I feel really at home here. So, when it was sort of talks began and it was weighing things up, for me there was only really one thing I wanted and this was to stay at Liverpool. “I really believe it’s a club going in the right direction. We’ve got great people, great staff, great facilities and great aspirations as well. So, yeah, I’m really excited to stay and I hope we can just kick on a lot in the next few years.” Liverpool and Fisk are next in action when they face Arsenal on Sunday.

item.title: Jon Rahm makes PGA Tour return harder to ignore, takes Abu Dhabi lead over Rory McIlroy
item.description: Jon Rahm admitted ahead of the DP World Tour's first playoff event at the Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship at Yas Links that he'd love a Brooks Koepka-like deal to return to the PGA Tour, even though he turned down the same offer about a year ago. Now he seems intent on making it tougher to ignore him. Rahm fired a 66 in the third round, moving into a one-stroke lead atop a power-packed leaderboard. The Spaniard used an eagle on the 11th hole to kickstart his round, and he now leads Tyrrell Hatton and Francesco Laporta by a stroke, while Rory McIlroy is just another stroke behind that duo in solo fourth. The PGA Tour's CEO, Brian Rolapp, said in September he wasn't expecting any similar programs for players to be able to return from, but Rahm is proving he's an asset the league will need to consider. Jon Rahm takes the solo lead once again! He's five under thru six holes on his back nine 📈 #AbuDhabiChamps | #RolexSeries pic.twitter.com/LogOrT7Gxn — DP World Tour (@DPWorldTour) November 7, 2026 Meanwhile, McIlroy has made as many birdies through three days as he ever has on the DP World Tour, but a double-bogey and another costly bogey on the 17th hole have him just off the lead. He still feels he can be in the mix tomorrow despite the miscues. “I played some really good golf out there, but also a little rough. I felt like I had some really good momentum coming off the back of the front-nine birdie and then birdieing nine. I was in a good position on 10. The bunker shot came out a lot faster than I anticipated and went over the green, and I was sort of dead from there. I followed a poor shot with another mistake with the third and ended up making a mess and making a double," McIlroy said. “But then I fought back and made birdies on the next four holes, so it was a good bounce back. I just sort of let it go a little bit at the end with the bogey on 17 and then didn’t take advantage of the last. But overall, a good day. I kept myself within touching distance, and I’ve got a good shot at it tomorrow, which is all I want.” DP World Tour Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship Place Player Third round Score to par 1 Jon Rahm 66 -18 T-2 Tyrrell Hatton 67 -17 T-2 Francesco Laporta 67 -17 4 Rory McIlroy 67 -16 5 Adam Scott 66 -15 T-6 Matthew Jordan 69 -14 T-6 David Puig 68 -14 Tim Schmitt is the managing editor of Golfweek and the golf coordinator of the USA Today Network. item.title: Max Verstappen to start Brazilian GP from back of grid as Red Bull confirms penalty
item.description: Motorsport photo Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen will start the Brazilian Grand Prix from the back of the grid, Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has confirmed. Red Bull's head of strategy Hannah Schmitz explained after the second practice session at Interlagos that the Milton Keynes outfit was "looking into several changes for Max's car. There were things he was unhappy with, but we know what they are so can work on them." Speaking with Sky Sports F1 ahead of the third practice session, Mekies confirmed the penalty for the Dutchman. "We will have to take an engine penalty with Max. He will start from the back - a position he knows very well here after the last two years," Mekies said. "He's done a few miracles in the past starting from the back here and we're sure he will do a few more this year." Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing While Verstappen will take the penalty, Mekies added that the pace of the car was "decent" during the first two practice sessions. "It's always hard work on Friday. It wasn't bad at all," he explained. "The pace of the car was decent. Yes, you heard a lot of radio communication, but certainly for us, I'm not sure for the other guys, there are a number of things we are chasing on a Friday to optimise lap time to extract everything. "In many respects, the progress we've had this year is because of this spirit we have of chasing everything. That was no different yesterday and hopefully we have the car in a better place today." After winning the Mexican Grand Prix last weekend, Verstappen moved up to second in the drivers' championship. Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli claimed the title in Mexico City, but the fight for second continues. Only 16 points separate Verstappen in second place and Charles Leclerc in fifth. Lewis Hamilton and George Russell sit third and fourth, respectively, and both will also be taking penalties. Russell will receive a five-place grid penalty, while the extent of Hamilton's penalty is yet to be confirmed. To read more Motorsport.com articles visit our website .

He is approaching free agency in 2028, and with the Brewers looking for a future catcher from there and beyond, an extension for Contreras has to be in play. Entering 2027, Contreras is under team control for one more year. While he would have been arbitration-eligible, the Brewers signed him to a one-year contract with an option last offseason. The Brewers may have been able to save a little money by declining the option and heading to arbitration, but they elected not to go that route this time. (Photo by Steph Chambers/Getty Images) Getty While Luka Doncic erupted for 53 points in a win over the Portland Trail Blazers on Friday, the Los Angeles Lakers also had several encouraging performances at the developmental level. Friday night marked the season opener for the Lakers’ G League affiliate, Coachella Valley, and its first game since relocating from El Segundo and rebranding from South Bay. Coachella Valley survived a late scare to defeat the Salt Lake City Stars 104-98, opening the 2026-27 campaign on a winning note. Bronny James and 2026 first-round pick Cameron Carr both featured in the contest, delivering encouraging performances as they look to strengthen their cases for larger roles with the Lakers at the NBA level. Lakers Guard Bronny James Impresses With 22-Point Performance James started in the backcourt and played 29 minutes in his G League season debut, recording 22 points, five rebounds and seven assists. The 22-year-old also registered one steal and committed just one turnover while shooting 8-of-18 from the field, 1-of-5 from three-point range and 4-of-5 from the free-throw line. James finished just one point behind Cole Swider , who led all scorers with 23 points off the bench. The performance came in James’ 38th career G League appearance after he averaged 13.7 points, 3.2 rebounds, 3.9 assists and 1.1 steals for South Bay last season. At the NBA level, James has struggled to establish himself in the Lakers’ rotation. Through five appearances this season, he has played just 12.4 minutes in total, recording four points without registering a rebound, assist or steal. With James entering his third season in Los Angeles, another extended spell in the G League appears likely as he continues his development and looks to secure a more consistent role with the franchise. Meanwhile, Carr made his G League debut, finishing with 13 points and four rebounds in 19 minutes. The rookie shot 5-of-11 from the field but failed to connect from beyond the arc. Although Carr did not dominate offensively, he showed flashes of his potential, including an aggressive drive to the basket that resulted in an and-one opportunity for his first points. It was an encouraging introduction for a rookie still adjusting to the pace and physicality of professional basketball, particularly in the often unpredictable G League environment. Portugal has named Real Madrid midfielder Bernardo Silva as its new national team captain following Cristiano Ronaldo ’s international retirement. The 32-year-old, who ended his trophy-filled spell at Manchester City this summer, will inherit the armband after Ronaldo concluded his remarkable 23-year international career. Portugal manager Jorge Jesus confirmed the leadership change during Friday’s squad announcement ahead of the upcoming UEFA Nations League fixtures. Transfer insider Fabrizio Romano reported Silva’s new captaincy role on Saturday, signaling the beginning of a new chapter for Portuguese soccer. Jesus also identified Ruben Dias, Joao Cancelo, Ruben Neves and Bruno Fernandes as other potential captains. The Portuguese manager praised Silva’s experience and current performances at Real Madrid. He highlighted the midfielder’s ability to compete regularly at one of Europe’s biggest clubs. Silva joined Madrid during the summer after leaving Manchester City, where he enjoyed considerable domestic and European success. His growing influence at club level now coincides with greater responsibility for his country. Meanwhile, Ronaldo’s departure closes an extraordinary chapter in Portugal’s history. The 41-year-old retired with 234 international appearances and 146 goals, both men’s international records. Ronaldo had previously opened up about his eventual retirement plans , emphasizing the importance of maintaining his motivation to continue playing. He also helped Portugal win the 2016 European Championship and two UEFA Nations League titles. Portugal will begin its post-Ronaldo era with Nations League fixtures against Denmark on November 14 and Wales on November 17. For Silva, replacing one of soccer’s most influential captains brings significant expectations. Portugal will now look to its experienced midfielder to guide the national team into a new era. item.title: Green Bay Packers youngsters bag two NFL monthly awards for October
item.description: Green Bay Packers defensive backs Evan Williams and Brandon Cisse were named the NFL Defensive Player of the Month and NFC Defensive Rookie of the Month for October, as officially confirmed on Thursday. Williams became only the third safety in franchise history to win the NFL Defensive Player of the Month award, joining teammate Xavier McKinney (2024) and Atari Bigby (2007). Meanwhile, Cisse became the first Packers rookie since Edgerrin Cooper (December/January 2025) to win the NFC Defensive Rookie of the Month award. How Evan Williams performed for the Green Bay Packers in October Oct 18, 2026; Green Bay, Wisconsin, USA; Green Bay Packers safety Evan Williams (33) celebrates during the game against the Dallas Cowboys at Lambeau Field. Mandatory Credit: Jeff Hanisch-Imagn Images In October, Evan Williams tallied 41 tackles, two interceptions, one sack, and one fumble recovery in five games against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, Chicago Bears, Dallas Cowboys, Detroit Lions, and the Carolina Panthers. According to PFF , the Oregon product logged the highest overall grade among defensive players last month (90.9). When targeted in coverage, Williams allowed only seven catches for 58 yards and didn’t concede a TD, and opposing quarterbacks only had a 21.1 passer rating. How Brandon Cisse performed for the Green Bay Packers in October Oct 29, 2026; Green Bay, Wisconsin, USA; Green Bay Packers cornerback Brandon Cisse (2) following the game against the Carolina Panthers at Lambeau Field. The 21-year-old South Carolina product was the only rookie defensive back to notch at least 20 tackles and one interception last month. Cisse recorded his first career NFL interception against Dak Prescott and the Dallas Cowboys in Week 6 . Per PFF, the 21-year-old allowed 144 receiving yards and zero touchdowns on 24 targets across 203 coverage snaps. The longest completion he allowed was only 18 yards, for a 58.1 passer rating for opposing quarterbacks. item.description: Hutto defensive end Noah Carlock (6) and defensive back Carson Fields (3) celebrate a stop on fourth down during the game against Vandegrift at Hutto Memorial Stadium on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026 in Hutto, Texas. (Aaron E. Martinez/Austin American-Statesman) HUTTO - It's going to take a special effort to slow down the Hutto offense in the playoffs. Fresh coming off their bye week , the Hippos threw some wrinkles into their usual offense Friday. Hutton running back Brayden Childs (11) runs the ball during the game against Vandegrift at Hutto Memorial Stadium on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026 in Hutto, Texas. (Aaron E. Martinez/Austin American-Statesman) Instead of being their normal pass-happy selves, with Micah Antoun throwing to the wildly talented trio of Jaiden Fields, Dylan Owens and Carson Fields on the way to averaging 55 ppg, the Hippos ran at varying times the option, the Wildcat and plays without anyone in the backfield when they lined up. The result was the same, though, with Hutto exploding for 431 yards of offense during a 49-10 rout of Vandegrift at Hutto Memorial Stadium to claim the top seed in the Division I playoffs out of District 24-6A. "We had a little time to reset with our open week," Hutto coach Casey Walraven said. "Once we got started, it was just one after another … and we dialed it up pretty good tonight. But it's all up to the kids executing it, and they did a fantastic job all the way around." Facing a fourth-and-2 at its own 45 on the game's opening possession, the Hippos had Jaiden Fields - an Oklahoma commit and the team's star wideout and defensive back - line up at quarterback. With his brother Carson next to him, he ran the option, pitching to Carson, who sprinted down the home sideline for a touchdown. Jaiden Fields would later throw a TD on a double pass. item.title: 'It's something I wanted to try!' – Andoni Iraola opens up on Bradley Barcola's new central role
item.description: Liverpool v Brighton & Hove Albion - Premier League 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola has addressed Bradley Barcola's position ahead of Sunday's trip to Crystal Palace. The France international was deployed as a central striker in midweek, with Iraola explaining the tactical thinking behind the experiment. Iraola explains Barcola's midweek central role Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola has outlined his plans for Bradley Barcola ahead of the Premier League trip to Selhurst Park. The France winger moved away from his typical flank role to lead the line centrally during Wednesday's Champions League clash against Fenerbahce. The Reds visit Crystal Palace looking to maintain their unbeaten top-flight record on the road this season. Iraola confirmed that while Barcola remains primarily a wide player, his versatility offers valuable tactical solutions. Iraola details winger alternatives and PSG history Addressing Barcola's tactical flexibility, Iraola highlighted the 24-year-old's previous experience in France while explaining his choice to test him centrally. "Bradley is a winger," Iraola stated at his pre-match press conference. "Mostly he has played as a left winger, sometimes as a right winger, but he also has played in PSG as a striker." "It's something that I wanted to try. I thought against their centre-backs he could be a threat, especially in behind," the manager added. Tactical options when main strikers need rest Iraola clarified that Barcola will spend the vast majority of his time in wide areas, though he remains an option to rotate with central forwards like Cody Gakpo and Alexander Isak. "He is a winger and he will be mostly – 90 per cent of the time – used as a winger. But it's alternatives that I sometimes want to try," Iraola explained. "I tried with Cody against Chelsea in the Carabao Cup. Not maybe from the beginning but it's true that during the game, I think it's options that we can use when Alex is tired and we need another type of striker," he noted. Reds look to extend strong away record Liverpool travel to London seeking a fourth consecutive Premier League away victory, having taken 10 of their 15 points on the road this term. Iraola himself remains unbeaten in all 13 of his Premier League away fixtures in 2026, putting him on the verge of joining an elite group of managers. item.title: Toto Wolff Hits Back at MotoGP Riders Who ‘Know Nothing’ About Geopolitics
item.description: Toto Wolff says he would have taken MotoGP’s hard line on Qatar, but he will respect any Mercedes staff who don’t want to travel to F1’s Middle East races. While F1 was crowning Kimi Antonelli champion in Mexico, MotoGP had a crisis brewing in Malaysia over traveling to Qatar for this weekend’s Grand Prix. The race is going ahead without Yamaha, who decided to skip the weekend . MotoGP will sanction the team under its contracts. Several riders also voiced reservations and were warned of action by the promoters, but most are racing, apart from a few who are injured. F1 heads to the same region for its final two rounds, in Qatar and Abu Dhabi, and as things stand, both races will go ahead as scheduled. There is an unofficial warning to the F1 drivers not to speak against any decision. Mercedes boss Wolff criticized riders who spoke out without knowing the geopolitics, but said anyone who chooses not to travel is making a personal decision he respects. The 2025 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix. Image Credit: Rudy Carezzevoli/Getty Images via Red Bull Content Pool ‘You Want to Ride or Drive, Go’ Wolff has full faith in F1 and the FIA to make the right call, and as things are, he doesn’t see any issue despite warnings from Iran of an attack on high-profile events due to provocations from the United States and Israel. “Stefano and Mohammed have been pretty clear about the situation that Formula 1 follows what the international guidelines are, whether there are travel restrictions, airlines not flying, any warnings in the region, the kind of feedback that local governments are making,” said Wolff in Friday’s press conference at Interlagos. “So not only the promoters, but what the local governments are making. And this is what you need to rely on, in my opinion, and I’m fully with that. I think that if riders stand up, who know nothing geopolitically about what’s going on, but have an audience that listens, I think that is something that creates media value. “But I would have done the same as MotoGP management has done. You want to ride or drive, go. If you don’t want to, don’t go. It’s as simple as that, and everybody can take their personal decisions on that, and I respect it,” he said. Wolff Will Respect Staff Who Don’t Want to Go The 2025 Qatar Grand Prix. Image Credit: Red Bull Content Pool If the situation gets more dangerous, Wolff trusts Stefano Domenicali and Mohammed Ben Sulayem to act, with Imola on standby as a replacement and a decision on it due within days. He also said that if someone on his team doesn’t want to travel, that’s fine, and it could give someone else a chance. “Of course, you’ve got to be wary of what’s happening in the next few days, a few weeks, and Stefano has his finger on the pulse to monitor that,” Wolff said. “If things were to get more dangerous, and we would get that feedback, then he’s going to be the first one, together with Mohammed, to protect the people that were meant to travel. So that’s why I’m following their guidance.

item.title: 2. Bundesliga: Second-half goals help Nürnberg sink Darmstadt
item.description: 2. Bundesliga: Second-half goals help Nürnberg sink Darmstadt Piet Scobel's sixth goal of the season helped Nürnberg to a home win over relegation-threatened Darmstadt. Miroslav Klose's men broke the deadlock early in the second-half before William Bøving's first goal for the club sealed the three points. The 21-year-old Scobel already tripled his tally from last season as he finally scored for the first time since Mohamed Ali Zoma's injury. After a well-worked move by the hosts, the striker provided a clinical finish with a low shot. With Darmstadt opening up more gaps in search of a late equalizer, Bøving puts the result beyond doubt after the rebound of Alexander Brunst's save from Rayan Ghrieb's attempt fell kindly to him. It was a first league start for the Danish midfielder after completing his loan move from Mainz 05. Darmstadt's best chances of the game did come after that as Yannik Lührs’ strike ruled out for an offside before Ibrahim El Kadiri's effort in the 95th minute. Florian Kohfeldt's men advanced to the Round of 16 in the DFB-Pokal, but they're in the relegation zone in 2. Bundesliga. Nürnberg, who are in process of replacing Eintracht Frankfurt-bound Joti Chatzialexiou with the new sporting director Dieter Frey, won at home for the first time since October's international break.
